guard: every package's typecheck also reads its smoke tree, so a planted type error in any smoke file reddens pnpm typecheck
why: Before this lane, each root's typecheck only compiled src, so a type error planted in a smoke file passed the gate silently and only surfaced, if at all, at run time under tsx, which strips types without checking them.

The fix hangs a second, smoke-scoped tsc config off the same typecheck script per root; this fixture plants one line in one smoke file per covered root and asserts that root's typecheck alone turns red on it.
tsc has no shared line across a red and a green run to key a completionMarker on, so this fixture carries no completionMarker and instead matches expectRed as a substring of the red run's own output.
